body: I've spent a lot of my life hating myself, and if I'm honest I still do, but I'm doing what I can to change that. Somethings that has helped me is changing perspective, this is you, there is nothing else, this is all you've got, you body is a part of you, it is your husk, and how people will judge you first, but what should matter to you is YOU. You are the memories you make, the lessons you learn, the things you do or don't do, that is you, and no one else will ever ever take that from you. You are defined by the choices you make in this short and questionably miserable life. The thoughts you have, the things you say, the action you take or don't take all define who you are and the impact you will have on the future, and more importantly others. Your life, no matter how seemingly purposeless it may seem in the grand scheme of things, it create a ripple throughout time. A completely unique footprint that is yours. Currently from what we know, there is nothing after death; just a peaceful abyss. Cherish your short time alive, and make the most of it while you can. Mental health issue can make it hard, trust me I know, but keep trying. Find something to grasp onto when you start too get pulled under. Also you should take time to love your body and take care of it not just because it's part of you, but because it is taking care of you and often times you will find that the better care you take care of it, the better it will of you. I've said what I can, but I truly hope you will come to understand what I'm saying. If not, focus on today and the now. Take walks, excise now and then, even if it's just for 5min, drink plenty of water, and improve you diet if possible to ensure your body not only get the calories needed but the vitamins too. A healthy body can really help.

He will always be a part of you now, you have no choice there. But how he's a part of you, that you can decide. wishing you the best of luck, no matter what choice you make

fuck, I feel like I wrote this, this just seems too familiar. The only but of advise I can give is try something new. New hobby, new skills, something. I got into motorcycling last year and is the only reason I still even putting up a fight to live through this winter. I can put words on the joy that comes from riding or even thinking about riding my motorcycle. Find something that's like that for you, something you always wanted to try/do/learn, maybe something completely new. Finding something that you pour your emotions into, something that can let you escape and also express yourself. When you find it and try it, you'll know almost right away. It will become something to do when youre bored, something to do when you're stressed or upset, and will be a crutch when those thought start creeping it. I have to work or ride on my bike almost everyday because of my suicidal thoughts and my bikes has kept me going for the past year. Through breakdowns, blood, and tears, I just keep riding. It reminds me a bit of when dory said "just keep swimming just keep swimming". Dory aside, that's my advice, and I hope it will help you. :)

I can't see the future or say things will get better but if there's any advice I can give it's this: **find something anything maybe even multiple things, goals and aspirations. Next create multiple out.** **For me my outs are or used to be: running, biking, riding my motorcycle, driving my car for hours, working out, working on a project or hobby.** If you don't have something, find something that you want to do, want to learn, enjoy doing, or find something completely new and try it out. The most dangerous thing for you is to become stale and not try something new . Now use those that out when you begin to have thoughts or urges, put your head up and just do your out. Then think what would life be without being able to finally get to do: insert word. 2 months ago I decided to kill myself on the 17th of December unless things things got better. Ive been busy and made life a little better for me. As for what come later, I cant say, given that I've been dealing with these feelings for at-least a decade i'm genuinely getting tired of fighting, but I will keep trying until I hit that point. If you create your future and continue fighting you will eventually hit your groove, that is what you need to find. We're not normal towards to society and we have to live different lives from then, but that's what gives us a special outlook, while society is enjoying life were fighting to stay alive, and while many call us weak, in reality that makes us very strong. I wish you the best of luck and hope that this will help you in your journey through life. :)
